title: Settings
subtitle: API credentials and attendance sync, saved per account
footerHint: Saved to the server for your account — syncs when you sign in elsewhere.

imile.title: iMile Bearer Token
imile.description: One token for all iMile API calls in this console. Update here when it expires.
imile.tokenHint: Paste the token segment after Bearer in the Authorization header.
imile.alertDescription: Groups are used only to fetch members; alerts go via DM, not group chat.

zkt.title: ZKT attendance API
zkt.description: Used when pulling attendance via API. Server re-authenticates when the session expires.
zkt.departmentsHint: Comma-separated department IDs sent to the attendance API.

about.title: About
about.description: Where data lives and how credentials are stored.
about.body: Local-first: payroll and scan data stay in your browser; exception samples use IndexedDB. Network calls go through the backend proxy only. Keep credentials secure.
about.offlineNote: 「Offline compute · local storage」means core data is not stored in remote business databases — it stays in this browser.
